defect.locator_note: content_page treatment frontmatter and rendered header Treatment: good (as of 2026-06-30)
defect.problem: The page presents an unqualified good_law treatment call as of 2026-06-30, but the disclosed lake record shows that the status is a migration seed and the treatment derivation still requires audit with proposed negative events. Under the default-to-refuted rule, the unqualified current good-law assertion is not verifiable from the disclosed evidence.
defect.proposed_fix: Do not render the treatment as unqualified good law until the R15 treatment audit resolves the proposed negative events; mark it as needs-review or as good_law only with an explicit migration-seed/audit-pending caveat.

reasons: The treatment field itself is good_law, but its composite_basis is migration-seed and the scope note says S2 derivation may downgrade it.

The lake provenance warns legacy treatment migrated: good -> good_law, and treatment.field_i_validity came from _treatment-migration.json + page frontmatter rather than a completed adverse-treatment audit.
All three derivation lanes shown for treatment have audit_needed true; lane2_top_cited reports 24 proposed_negative_events, and lane1_negative/lane3_recency also report proposed negative events.

The proposed edges include overruled, abrogated, and questioned labels, but they are marked proposed with point null and field_iii mentioned, so they do not prove bad law; they do prevent verifying the unqualified good-law claim from the disclosed record.
residual_risks: A completed audit may ultimately confirm Pearson remains good law, but that evidence is not disclosed here.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Render as treatment needs review, or state: good_law status is migration-seeded and pending R15 adverse-treatment audit.
